gr-xendit-7997856003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

We are seeking a highly motivated and strategically-minded Account Manager to own and grow our regional/global enterprise portfolio, based in our Jakarta office, working in a hybrid model. This position is dedicated to our most complex and high-value enterprise clients — primarily cross-border e-commerce leaders, global SaaS platforms, and large-scale financial institutions across Indonesia and the wider APAC region. You’ll join Xendit’s Enterprise Account Management team, working closely with Go-to-Market, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Risk leadership. You will not just manage accounts — you will architect growth.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of B2B account management or strategic sales experience in financial services, fintech, or payments.
• Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets, ideally in a role with direct P&L, book-of-business, or portfolio revenue ownership.
• Experience managing and growing revenue within large and complex enterprise accounts.
• You understand the needs of international cross-border merchants and the cultural nuances of doing business across APAC markets. Familiarity with the APAC region is essential.
• Professional proficiency in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Core Competencies:
• Builder & Founder-Like Mentality: You thrive in “zero-to-one” environments. You are hands-on, take full ownership, and are relentless in removing blockers for your clients and your team.
• Exceptional Communicator: You can present persuasively in the boardroom, and translate complex payment concepts for executive audiences.
• Data-Led & Analytical: You make decisions based on data, not gut feel. You can analyze transaction patterns to identify risk and untapped potential.

Attributes We Value:

• Hustle with Integrity: You move fast, but you build trust through transparency and reliability.
• Curiosity: You constantly ask “why” and dig deep to understand the root problem, not just the surface request.
• Resilience: You are undeterred by long sales cycles and complex procurement processes.

Responsibilities

1.⁠ ⁠Strategic Portfolio Growth & Revenue Ownership

• Own the full P&L for a portfolio of key enterprise accounts. Drive revenue and transaction volume through upselling, cross-selling (payment acceptance, payouts, platform business) and use case expansion.
• Develop and execute comprehensive 12-18 month account plans for each major client, articulating clear growth strategies and proactively managing churn risk.
• Consistently exceed revenue targets by focusing on high-impact input metrics and maintaining a clean, accurate pipeline.

2.⁠ ⁠Executive & Multi-Stakeholder Relationship Building

• Build and nurture C-level relationships (CEO, CFO, CPO, CTO) within your accounts. Understand their strategic objectives and align Xendit’s roadmap to solve their core business challenges.
• Lead client business reviews, providing data-driven insights and demonstrating clear ROI.
• Serve as the trusted advisor and single point of contact, navigating complex organizational structures to secure client buy-in and consensus.

3.⁠ ⁠Cross-Functional Influence

• Bring your clients’ needs back to Xendit, informing and influencing our product roadmap and strategy.
• Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Solution Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Risk) to identify and scope net-new opportunities, bridging the gap between commercial terms and technical feasibility.

4.⁠ ⁠Market Intelligence & Local Expertise

• Stay ahead of regulatory shifts and payment trends. Act as a subject matter expert on cross-border flows between Xendit markets in APAC.
• Identify synergies between Xendit’s licensed infrastructure and the specific needs of enterprises expanding into the region.

Why Join Xendit?

• Impact at Scale: You won’t be a small cog in a giant machine. You will own a significant book of business that directly impacts Xendit’s regional growth.
• Licensed Infrastructure: Sell more than just a gateway. You have acquiring, remittance , banking, VASP, and lending licenses as your arsenal.
• Culture of Builders: We are a team of doers. We hire people who want to build, not just maintain.
• Accelerated Career Growth: We promote from within and offer high-visibility projects with direct exposure to global leadership.

Xendit is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Supervise and coordinate daily B2B sales activities to ensure achievement of targets and objectives. Support key account management and customer engagement initiatives within assigned segments. Guide and monitor sales staff performance to maintain productivity and service standards. Track sales metrics, monitor progress, and prepare reports for management. Assist in sales planning, operational coordination, and providing market insights for strategic decisions.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
